description: Quotes a search of national property data: any US property, including NYC properties that are not in preforeclosure. Filters: place (state plus zip, city or county), property type, beds, baths, value, equity, year built, distress flags (preforeclosure, foreclosure, auction, bank-owned, vacant, absentee owner, high equity, free and clear, inherited) and owner filters (company-owned, out-of-state owner, cash buyer, owners of N+ properties, last sale dates). Never spends credits: it counts the matches and prices one batch. Always quote first. Then tell the user the credit cost, the batch size and their balance after. Records this workspace already pulled in the last 24 hours are free. For large searches, prefer a smaller batch (limit) or narrower filters, such as a zip instead of a county. One run returns at most 250 records; page with offset. Quotes expire after 10 minutes. Call run_national_property_search with the quote_id only after the user agrees to the credit cost.

corporateOwned.description: Only properties owned by a company or LLC.

county.description: County name, without the word County.

flags.description: Only properties with all of these: pre_foreclosure, foreclosure, auction, reo (bank-owned), vacant, absentee_owner, high_equity, free_clear (no mortgage), inherited, death (owner deceased, a probate signal), judgment (judgment lien), tax_lien, mls_cancelled (listing cancelled or expired, a failed sale), negative_equity.

lastSoldAfter.description: Last sale on or after this date.

lastSoldBefore.description: Last sale on or before this date.

limit.description: Records to price in this batch (max 250). Leave empty to let the quote pick a safe batch size.

offset.description: Skip this many matches. Use it to quote the next page.

outOfStateOwner.description: Only owners whose mailing address is in another state.

ownerPropertiesMin.description: Only owners who own at least this many properties.

propertyType.description: SFR single family, MFR multifamily, CONDO, LAND, MOBILE or OTHER.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. TX. Required.

zip.description: Five-digit zip code. The narrowest and cheapest place filter.

name: quote_national_property_search
title: Quote a national property search
